New theories and speculation (Contains Vengeance spoilers!)

 

Now that vengeance is out, its time to update and re-evaluate some of my theories and speculations.

GI Bunker- I was very off about Pike being a Bunker pilot. I do wonder if GI bunker is related to Steven Graves (Fright Train).  His father/grandfather being a former Bunker pilot could explain the inferiority complex and continuing dislike of Tyler vance.  Something along the lines of not being able to live up to his father/grandfather's legacy (a continuing theme in Sentinels).  It could also be yet another reason he takes up the Engine of War suit in the Iron Legacy timeline...

It could also be interesting if GI bunker became involved with FILTER- theres a rich comic book history of WW2 commandos getting involved in clandestine intelligence organizations...  (Director Graves?)

 

Expatriette's incap side:

We see in the Mobile defense platform environment that Citizen Dawn eventually takes control of the floating bases.  My guess is that this is after she is driven off Insula Primalis.  KNYFE's incap suggests that Citizen Dawn is an ongoing problem for our heroes, and I'm thinking that Expatriette's incap is during one of those fights.  I think that the yellow floating thing is the MDP- its the right shape and proportions.  I suspect that the flying figures are the Argent Adept and Revenant (He and Setback tend to run into each other all the time), so it could be RevoCorp (though theres really no reason it couldn't be both...)

Either way, she's getting back up.  It just might take her a while.  

 

The Arena:

One of Parse's cards shows her in an Arena.  I'm thinking that this is will be an upcoming environment, possibly the plaything of a War World style villain who kidnaps heroes to fight for his/her/its amusement.  This could explain Mainstay's incap- he has been captured to fight as a gladiator.  It could also explain the durasteel chains... durasteel sure sounds like a space metal!  The Sulph-orcs we see could be slavers?

My guess is that KNYFE's nemesis is the one who controls the arena- she's very geared to go after the central big bad, so the idea of her going straight for the Champion/Caesar of the Arena seems right...

 

FILTER

I think that we're going to get some answers about FILTER soon, and I think that they might end up being Sky-scraper's nemesis.  Their mission is to hunt aliens and keep earth safe (and also run prisons...), and the last Thorathian that came to Earth came as a conqueror.  So it seems likely that there is going to be some animosity at the very least!  

If they don't end up as Sky's nemesis, Bunker or Unity are good options.  They could be the people who capture Unity and stick her in a box (They have an affinity for cube-shaped prisons...), or if GI Bunker is involved as a director they could be involved in taking control of the Bunker Project.
